t.zh: 针孔小，进来的光少，图很暗；把孔开大，同一点的光会落到传感器上不同的地方，图就糊。相机台在针孔的位置换上一块焦距 50 mm 的透镜，开两个旋钮：<wiki-ref to="aperture"></wiki-ref>直径 A 管进来多少光，对焦距离是透镜对准的那个距离。
t.en: A small pinhole lets in little light and the image is dark; widen it and light from one point lands at different places on the sensor, and the image blurs. The camera bench puts a 50 mm lens where the hole was and opens two knobs: the <wiki-ref to="aperture"></wiki-ref> diameter A sets how much light comes in, and the focus distance is the distance the lens is set to.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：要让图更亮又不变糊，只把孔开大够吗？台上有近处的箱子和远处的树。进光量至少要到 4，近处的箱子还要清晰：它在传感器上的<wiki-ref to="blur-circle"></wiki-ref>不超过 0.03 mm。
t.en: This level asks: to make the image brighter without blurring it, is widening the hole enough? The bench holds a near crate and a far tree. The light must reach at least 4, and the near crate must be sharp: its <wiki-ref to="blur-circle"></wiki-ref> on the sensor no wider than 0.03 mm.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="lens"></wiki-ref>让大光圈进来的光重新会聚，但只对对焦距离上的点准，别处成模糊圈；光圈管亮度，焦距管像的大小。
after.en: A <wiki-ref to="lens"></wiki-ref> brings the light of a wide aperture back together, but only for points at the focus distance; others make blur circles. The aperture sets the light, the focal length the image size.

brief.zh: 调光圈和对焦距离：进光量不低于 4，近处的箱子清晰。
brief.en: Set the aperture and the focus distance: light at least 4, and the near crate sharp.

hint.zh: 光圈开大以后，看两个物体的模糊圈；再看对焦距离改变的是哪一个。
hint.en: After opening the aperture, watch both objects' blur circles; then see which one the focus distance changes.

why.zh: 只把光圈开大：光够了，可箱子不在对焦距离上，它的模糊圈随光圈一起变大。
why.en: Only opening the aperture: the light is enough, but the crate is not at the focus distance and its blur circle grows with the aperture.

why.zh: 只对焦、不开光圈：箱子清晰了，进光量仍然只有 0.16。
why.en: Only focusing, aperture unchanged: the crate is sharp, but the light is still only 0.16.
